description: Merck & Co., Inc. is a global health care company that delivers innovative health solutions through its prescription medicines, including biologic therapies, vaccines and animal health products, with operations principally managed on a product basis across two operating and reportable segments, Pharmaceutical and Animal Health. The Pharmaceutical segment includes human health pharmaceutical and vaccine products, where human health pharmaceutical products consist of therapeutic and preventive agents, generally sold by prescription, for the treatment of human disorders, sold primarily to drug wholesalers and retailers, hospitals, government agencies and managed health care providers such as health maintenance organizations and pharmacy benefit managers, and human health vaccine products consist of preventive pediatric, adolescent and adult vaccines sold primarily to physicians, wholesalers, distributors and government programs.
